facts.fact: The Minister of State for Health said the National Digital Health Blueprint implementation has put at least 7.2 million Nigerians on the National Health Information Exchange Platform.

The Minister of State for Health described a National Health Information Exchange Platform with at least 7.2 million Nigerians registered on it, and separately said over 200 hospitals are integrated with Electronic Medical Records systems and mHealth initiatives; as_of is the document's published date, none being given.

The Minister said the ministry will continue scaling up technology-enabled platforms to deliver a National Health Information Exchange System connecting public and private, tertiary, secondary and primary health facilities.
